image_description: A high-angle close-up shot of a scattered pile of disposable plastic lighters on a dark blue textured surface. The lighters vary in color (green, pink, purple, blue, white) and orientation. Several lighters show the metal wind guard and spark wheel mechanism clearly. One large translucent green lighter is prominent in the foreground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact handheld device sized to fit comfortably within a closed palm.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are clearly identifiable as standard disposable lighters, which by definition and visual proportion relative to each other fit the 'compact handheld' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular or cylindrical body with hinged lid or fixed top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible items exhibit the characteristic rectangular prism shape with rounded corners typical of disposable butane lighters. They have fixed tops (no flip-lids visible, but fixed top is a valid variant).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flame emerges from small metal tube at top when activated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: None of the lighters are currently ignited; therefore, the flame and its emergence point cannot be visually verified, though the nozzle structure is implied.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flint wheel or piezoelectric button ignition mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple lighters (e.g., the white one on the left, the green one in the center) clearly display the serrated metal spark wheel and the plastic actuator lever/button assembly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fuel nozzle producing flame from internal reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The metal wind guards and the central nozzle area beneath them are visible on several upright or tilted lighters, consistent with the fuel delivery system.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hinged flip-top lid or fixed top with spark wheel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lighters feature fixed tops integrated with the spark wheel mechanism, matching the 'fixed top' alternative in the checkpoint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal or plastic casing with brushed chrome or colored enamel finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The casings appear to be molded plastic with smooth, semi-gloss finishes in various solid colors (green, pink, purple), fitting the 'plastic casing... colored' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Internal butane or lighter fluid reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The reservoir is internal and opaque in most units; while the translucent green one hints at internal volume, the fluid itself and the sealed nature of the reservoir cannot be definitively audited visually.
The context and object identity confirm these are portable ignition devices.

artifact_observations.location: White label on the teal/light blue lighter in the upper-left quadrant
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the sticker appears to mimic branding (possibly 'BIC' style) but renders as nonsensical, blurred characters rather than legible letters, a common AI artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Junction between the metal wind guard and the plastic body on the central bright green lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection point where the metal hood attaches to the plastic head looks slightly soft and ill-defined, lacking the sharp mechanical precision expected of mass-produced metal-plastic assembly.

artifact_observations.location: Surface reflections on the large translucent green lighter in the foreground
artifact_observations.reasoning: The specular highlights are overly smooth and 'waxy,' lacking the micro-scratches or mold lines typically found on used or even new plastic disposables.
